---
title: "Inputs and shared website data"
format: html
---

The newsletter workspace is nested inside the website repository. Its `_data`
path points to the website's shared data, so input ownership is visible but not
local to this directory.

The recurring inputs are:

- the newest `Newsletter_Content_Triage.csv` export;
- historical event and opportunity records;
- BibTeX files for articles, blogs, and media;
- edition metadata in `params.yml`;
- the Markdown section files and their images.

When a new export arrives, keep the original until the replacement has been
checked. The helper notebook can consolidate the working copy after that
review.
